WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id",
    customers.tier AS "customers.tier"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.id,
    customers.tier
), _cm_customers__orders__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
    customers.tier AS "orders.customers.tier",
    COUNT(orders.id) AS "orders.id_count"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer_id,
    customers.tier
), __slayer_stage_pc AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tier" AS "tier",
    _stage_inner."customers.n_orders" AS "n_orders"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _base_2."customers.tier",
      COALESCE(_cm_customers__orders__id_count."orders.id_count", 0) AS "customers.n_orders"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__id_count
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__id_count."orders.customer_id"
      AND _base_2."customers.tier" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__id_count."orders.customers.tier"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  pc.tier AS "pc.tier",
  COUNT(*) AS "pc.customers",
  SUM(pc.n_orders) AS "pc.orders",
  CAST(AVG(pc.n_orders) AS DOUBLE) AS "pc.avg_orders"
FROM __slayer_stage_pc AS pc
GROUP BY
  pc.tier
LIMIT 21
